Conexión RedJIV / Student guide

Your guide to a first contribution

Briefs for a first draft, with scope, review criteria and sources. These are educational proposals; confirm priority and review availability with the community before expanding the work.

This is not an emergency service. For urgent assistance, use your local official channels. Our work is remote and uses public information.
  1. Check three public sources (60 min)
  2. Learn to read a mapping task (120 min)
  3. Organise safe-water references (60 min)
  4. Review a page using your keyboard (60 min)
  5. Reproduce a table with synthetic data (120 min)
  6. Make an explanation clearer (60 min)

To join or confirm review:

Discord: https://discord.gg/yWhUUvrhpj
GitHub: https://github.com/venezuela-org/site/issues
Web: https://venezuela-org.github.io/site/en/

D · 60 min · Proposed · confirm before expanding

Check three public sources

Turn a list of links into a table another person can verify.

You will deliver

A 3-source table: institution, URL, purpose, consultation date and limitations.

You need

A browser and a spreadsheet or Markdown file.

Ready for review when…

  • Every link leads to the expected institutional domain.
  • Each row separates what was checked from what remains uncertain.
  • No personal data or unsupported claims about service availability are included.

Keep it within scope

Do not contact affected people or test forms with real data. A reachable page does not prove a service is operational.

Starting points

  • ICRC · Venezuela
  • UNICEF · Venezuela
  • Starter template or example

B · 120 min · Proposed · confirm before expanding

Learn to read a mapping task

Explore HOT’s workflow and explain how to start without duplicating effort.

You will deliver

A 1-page note with a public project link, prerequisites and 3 beginner questions.

You need

A browser. This note does not require an account or map editing.

Ready for review when…

  • The project status and consultation date are recorded, without assuming contributions are open.
  • Project training and instructions are linked.
  • The note explains that later edits must follow HOT’s review process.

Keep it within scope

Onboarding documentation only. Do not publish people’s locations, infer aid needs or edit maps before completing required training.

Starting points

  • HOT · Tasking Manager

C · 60 min · Proposed · confirm before expanding

Organise safe-water references

Help a reviewer find and compare institutional documents.

You will deliver

An annotated bibliography of 3 documents: date, audience, scope and link.

You need

A browser and a text document.

Ready for review when…

  • Each document has an institutional author, title, date or unknown-date note, and URL.
  • Annotations distinguish general context from technical instructions.
  • The draft explicitly states that it is not guidance for field use.

Keep it within scope

Do not recommend doses, treatments or procedures. Do not adapt health instructions for distribution; practical materials require specialist review.

Starting points

  • ICRC · Venezuela
  • UNICEF · Venezuela

A · 60 min · Proposed · confirm before expanding

Review a page using your keyboard

Find one concrete barrier for someone getting started.

You will deliver

A report with the page, reproduction steps, expected result and observed result.

You need

A browser and a keyboard. No paid tools required.

Ready for review when…

  • The path can be repeated with Tab, Shift+Tab and Enter.
  • Visible focus, descriptive links and use at 200% zoom are checked.
  • One concrete observation is documented without claiming a full audit.

Keep it within scope

Review public content only. Do not capture names, private messages or other people’s data.

Repository · Conexión RedJIV

D · 120 min · Proposed · confirm before expanding

Reproduce a table with synthetic data

Practise a small analysis without handling data about people.

You will deliver

A change to the 5-row synthetic example, with expected and observed totals, a manual check and a run command.

You need

Python 3 or JavaScript with Node.js, and a text editor.

Ready for review when…

  • Rows are labelled synthetic and contain no names, contacts or locations.
  • One command reproduces the result and the runtime version is documented.
  • Totals are checked by hand and the example’s limits are explained.

Keep it within scope

A reproducibility exercise, not an assessment of real needs. Do not collect or scrape victim or patient data.

Starting points

  • Starter template or example

A · 60 min · Proposed · confirm before expanding

Make an explanation clearer

Help someone understand the next step without knowing the jargon.

You will deliver

A 150–250-word before/after proposal and a 5-term glossary, in Spanish or English.

You need

A text editor and a public section of this repository.

Ready for review when…

  • The proposal preserves meaning without adding facts or promises.
  • Five terms are explained and the original text is linked.
  • Translation or content questions are marked for review.

Keep it within scope

Do not translate clinical or safety instructions for operational use. Choose onboarding or collaboration documentation.

Repository · Conexión RedJIV

When sharing your draft

  • A summary of what you did and who could use it.
  • The file or link, without personal data.
  • Sources and consultation dates.
  • Steps to check or reproduce the result.
  • Limitations, questions and any AI assistance used.

A message to get started

Hi, I am a student and would like to contribute to: [task name].
I can offer [hours per week] for [period].
My first draft would be: [deliverable].
Is this task still useful? Is someone available to review it?
I will use public information only, without personal data.

To join or confirm review: https://discord.gg/yWhUUvrhpj
